changesMade: h1 (181:507) now fills its Title column (`w-full`) instead of shrink-to-fit. Mechanism: in Figma the headline text node is stretched to the full 1002px of the Title frame with `text-align: center`; under the flex parent's `items-center` our h1 was hugging its longest line (787px at the current fallback face). That is exactly the largest reported position delta - 1002-787 = 215 wide, (1002-787)/2 = 108 right, vs the reported '217px narrower / 108px right'. Centred text renders pixel-identically either way; only the measured box changes.

Headline break moved from `lg:` to `md:` and the NBSP replaced with an ordinary space. Mechanism (measured against the actual Newsreader fallback metrics on disk, wght 450, -0.04em): at 768 the column is 696px and the forced break gives 320px / 420px - two clean lines - instead of the flagged 'AI compute at the maritime' + orphaned 'edge.'. Below md the break is dropped and the plain space lets the line fall after 'the' ('AI compute at the' 309px / 'maritime edge.' 257px in a 318px column), i.e. two balanced lines rather than the NBSP's three with 'edge.' alone. The explicit
is strictly stronger than the NBSP the design uses, so the drawn two-line composition still holds at every width >= 768 regardless of which face loads.

CTA label wrapped in its own `<span data-figma-id="181:709">`. Mechanism: the text node is a separate 134x16 node inside the 174x40 pill, but with the label as a bare text child the measurement matched 181:709 against the whole <a> - which is precisely why it reported '20px left, 18px down, 46px wider, 24px taller' (the pill's 20px/12px padding). No visual change.
summary: Closed the largest measured position delta by stretching the h1 to its 1002px Figma column, fixed the tablet headline's orphaned 'edge.' (and the same orphan at mobile) with a measured md:/base break, and gave the CTA label its own node so 181:709 stops being measured as the pill.

WARNING - h1 falls back to Newsreader (780px ink vs Figma's 879px) and the lead sets 5 lines instead of 4. Both have the same root cause and the same fix: no Exposure/Matter WOFF2 exists in the repo, so the substitute faces need `size-adjust` (and ~600 weight for the display face) on their @font-face. I verified the mechanism numerically with the fonts on disk - only the lead's first line overruns, by 17.1px against the correct 383px measure (Inter 500 sets 'Autonomous vessels take AI compute' at 400.1px), which is what pushes 'compute' to line 2 and the CTA 30px down (the '30px taller / 30px down' deltas on Text, the paragraph and the CTA are that one extra line). The fix belongs in src/app/fonts.ts + globals.css, both shared files owned by another agent this pass, so I left them alone; forcing the break in markup instead would need `white-space: nowrap` and a 17px overrun of the measure, which trades a real defect for a worse one.

Measurement gate 'arbitrary' margin-tops (148px / 96px / -12px): left as-is. All three are literal spec values with named tokens behind them (--space-6xl 148px title top, --space-4xl 96px title-to-lead, --space-xs 12px wordmark tuck); the audit's scale tops out at 64px, so snapping them would be an 84px/32px fidelity regression.
